categories.main_business_segments: Country Garden operates primarily in property development, construction, interior decoration, property investment, hotel development and management, robotics, and light-asset entrusted management and construction services. The Group focuses on residential projects including townhouses, condominiums, car parks, and retail shop spaces, alongside technology-enabled construction and related services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes technology-enabled construction, including the development and application of construction robots through its subsidiary Bright Dream Robotics. It employs a smart construction system integrating construction robots, prefabricated construction, smart equipment, and digitalization via Building Information Modeling (BIM) to enhance safety, quality, efficiency, and environmental protection in construction.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Country Garden serves residential property buyers, investors, and tenants in China’s urbanization market. Its customers include individuals purchasing homes in tier 1 to tier 4 cities across Mainland China, as well as clients for its hotel and property investment businesses. The Group also serves partners and clients in construction and technology-enabled construction services.
categories.geographic_coverage: The Group operates extensively across Mainland China, covering 242 cities in 31 provinces, municipalities, and autonomous regions. It has a significant presence in Guangdong province and other economically vibrant regions. Additionally, it has projects and operations in overseas locations including Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia, India, Australia, New Zealand, and the United States.
categories.supply_chain_position: Country Garden operates primarily in the downstream segment of the real estate supply chain as a property developer and manager. It also engages in midstream activities through construction services and technology-enabled construction, including robotics and prefabricated construction. The Group’s light-asset management and construction services further position it in service provision within the construction value chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The Group’s strategic focus is on integrating technology into construction, advancing robotics, prefabricated construction, smart equipment, and BIM digitalization to transform traditional construction. It pursues a 'One Core and Two Wings' strategy to enhance cost control, product quality, and service delivery. The company also emphasizes geographic diversification and expanding light-asset management and construction services.
categories.revenue_model: Country Garden generates revenue mainly through property sales, which accounted for over 97% of revenue in 2024. Additional revenue streams include technology-enabled construction services, property investment rental income, and hotel operations. The Group also earns from construction services and management fees in its light-asset entrusted management segment.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Country Garden is one of China’s largest residential property developers, positioning itself as a leader in property delivery volume and urbanization projects. It competes with other major Chinese real estate developers in a challenging market environment characterized by industry-wide adjustments and liquidity pressures. Its unique positioning includes a strong focus on technology-enabled construction and robotics.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the Group recorded revenue of approximately RMB252.8 billion, a 37% decrease from 2023, reflecting market challenges. It delivered over 380,000 housing units with a gross floor area of about 46.08 million square meters. The company faced significant losses, with a net loss attributable to owners of RMB32.8 billion in 2024, though this was an improvement from the prior year. The Group’s total assets were about RMB1.04 trillion with liabilities of RMB984.6 billion, and it is undergoing offshore debt restructuring to improve its capital structure.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Country Garden emphasizes creating high-quality, green, low-carbon, intelligent, and safe housing with comprehensive amenities and services. Its value proposition includes leveraging advanced construction robotics and smart construction systems to improve safety, quality, efficiency, and environmental sustainability. The Group also highlights its commitment to social responsibility, urbanization, and modernization, aiming to deliver exceptional living environments and contribute to societal happiness.
